1.why: Body text renders in a legible sans-serif, but letter and line spacing look default rather than generous and no dyslexia-friendly typeface is evident.

2.why: No italics, all-caps styling, or dense text blocks appear on either screen; every visible string is a short line.

3.why: The narrow single-column layout suits a phone, but both headings print literal escape strings (\u{1f3e6}, \u{1f9fe}) that undermine readability.

4.why: The few visible sentences are short and plain, yet the app never gives real enrolment instructions and the headings contain raw code escapes instead of plain words.

5.why: No example of expected input is shown anywhere; in fact no input fields exist at all.

6.why: Only brief one-line texts are displayed, so the user is never required to read a long block of text to proceed.

7.why: No codes or secrets are ever displayed and no copy-to-clipboard control exists, so nothing can be copied rather than typed.

8.why: Neither screen offers a QR code or any equivalent alternative to manual entry.

9.why: There are no form fields on either screen, so browser autofill and password-manager support is absent rather than supported.

10.why: No step indicator or standout primary action exists; the page shows only a header, a divider, and a 'Ready.' log entry.

11.why: Each screen requests zero actions rather than one clear main action, so the one-action-per-screen pattern is not actually implemented.

12.why: The only system message is 'Ready.', which never states what happened after an action or what comes next.

13.why: No retry, reveal/hide, or re-request controls appear anywhere in the two screens.

14.why: No error messages exist anywhere in the flow, so none can state the problem and the fix.

15.why: No countdown or timeout is visible, but the code-entry step itself is missing, so generous time to enter codes cannot be confirmed.
